name: Ghost at the Door
description: The hackerspace’s door controller stopped reporting after a midnight maintenance window. Find the controller on the lab network and recover the incident recovery token it holds. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. The challenge runs inside the lab network.

tasks.name: Recover the door controller token
tasks.description: Locate the hackerspace door controller on the lab network and recover its incident recovery token. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. The challenge runs inside the lab network.
hints: Some listeners stay quiet until a client begins a conversation. Compare how the open ports respond.
The controller speaks MQTT. Try beginning a session, then ask the broker for available messages.
After the broker accepts a session, subscribe broadly and inspect the retained message it sends back.
